card.name: Punctuation where a female subject comes next
card.fires_on: A comma or linking word right after a phrase that mentions a woman (her, herself, mother), where the next word is likely to be she or her. It appears in general web text about women.

modes.label: Comma after her-phrase
modes.description: A comma closing an opening phrase that contains her or herself, before a clause about that woman.
modes.example: An excellent clinician herself<<,>> she founded the Harvard Reading Laboratory in

modes.label: Verb or linking word before her
modes.description: A verb or preposition just before an expected object her, referring to a woman already named.
modes.example: Her mother<< trained>> her on the job

card.writes: It pushes toward female pronouns like she and her and away from them in the suppressed list; the promoted tokens are unclear.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence about a woman is about to continue with she or her.
